contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A question, an idea, or something you found that should not be there? This is how to reach Printopoly.
contact.intro: Printopoly is a hobby project by Niek Nijland. Got a question, an idea, or found a mistake? Send an email.
contact.abuse_title: Report something that is not allowed
contact.abuse_body: See something on Printopoly that you think is not allowed, such as a photo of yourself that you did not agree to? Email the same address and say what you see and where. The terms say more.
contact.security_body: Email it to this address. It is also listed in our security.txt.
